# DreamFactory

DreamFactory is a self-hosted API generation platform that creates production-ready REST APIs from any database in minutes. It provides governed API access for enterprise applications and AI agents.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.dreamfactory.com): DreamFactory homepage — governed API access to any data source
- [Features](https://www.dreamfactory.com/features): Self-hosted API generation, security, and governance features
- [Pricing](https://www.dreamfactory.com/pricing): DreamFactory pricing plans for teams and enterprises
- [AI Data Gateway](https://www.dreamfactory.com/ai): Give AI agents governed database access via REST APIs
- [About](https://www.dreamfactory.com/about): About DreamFactory Software Inc.
- [Request Demo](https://www.dreamfactory.com/demo): Request a live demo of DreamFactory

## Database Connectors

- [Snowflake](https://www.dreamfactory.com/connectors/snowflake): Generate REST APIs for Snowflake data warehouses
- [MS SQL Server](https://www.dreamfactory.com/connectors/sql-server): REST API generation for SQL Server databases
- [PostgreSQL](https://www.dreamfactory.com/connectors/postgresql): REST API generation for PostgreSQL databases
- [MySQL](https://www.dreamfactory.com/connectors/mysql): REST API generation for MySQL databases
- [Oracle](https://www.dreamfactory.com/connectors/oracle): REST API generation for Oracle databases
- [MongoDB](https://www.dreamfactory.com/connectors/mongodb): REST API generation for MongoDB collections
- [IBM DB2](https://www.dreamfactory.com/connectors/ibm-db2): REST API generation for IBM DB2 databases
- [Amazon DynamoDB](https://www.dreamfactory.com/connectors/dynamodb): REST API generation for DynamoDB tables
- [Amazon S3](https://www.dreamfactory.com/connectors/amazon-s3): File management APIs for S3 buckets
- [All Connectors](https://www.dreamfactory.com/connectors): Full list of 20+ supported database connectors
